title: Fourth Down Lab Static Dataset
licence_model: MIT (nfl4th / Ben Baldwin, sportsdataverse / Saiem Gilani)

excluded_snaps.reason: Victory formation / end-of-game kneel (not a competitive fourth down decision)

made_fgs_negative_wpa_audit.explanation: Audited raw play-by-play transitions confirm negative realised WPA on made field goals reflects faithful state transitions in the nflverse post-play win probability model (possession change and surrendered touchdown equity), not a perspective or join artefact.

punt_domain.rule: Inside opponent 31-yard line (yardline_100 < 31), punting is unmodelled in nfl4th empirical tables (0 punts in 2026 dataset). Comparisons are evaluated between the remaining 2 modelled options (Go vs Field Goal).
